name: Archive the real failed mission and prepare one finite legitimate retry

condition.code: local p=Players[Game.GetLocalPlayer()]; return p and p:IsTurnActive() and type(ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary)=='table'

steps.code: local b=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary; local d=b.EnemyRetryDiagnosis(); assert(d.spyID==655368 and d.eventID==0 and d.eventTurn==23 and d.mission.turn==23,'preserved real mission checkpoint differs'); assert(d.mode=='PRODUCE' or d.mode=='RETURN' or d.mode=='MAP','native retry unavailable: '..d.mode..' '..d.outcome); b.Queue('BEGIN_SPY_RETRY'); return 'archive of failed native mission queued'

condition.code: local a=ExposedMembers.JAC_PersonaBoundary.lastAction; if a=='ERROR_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY' or a=='UNKNOWN_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY' or a=='REJECTED_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY' then error(a) end; return a=='ACCEPTED_BEGIN_SPY_RETRY'

steps.code: local r=assert(Game:GetProperty('JAC_BOUNDARY_ENEMY_SPY_RETRY')); assert(r.current==2 and r.archive.eventID==0 and r.archive.spyID==655368,'failed mission archive changed'); return r.mode
